title: Create aura&adorn affiliate marketing website for fashion, jewelry, and luxury products

requirements.text: Create a responsive marketing website branded as "aura&adorn" focused on fashion, jewelry, and luxury products, including a Home page with brand headline, featured product sections, and clear navigation to categories.

quotes: Hey! I want to create a affiliate website for marketing, account name is aura&adorn and it's basically about fashion,jewelry and luxury products.

acceptanceCriteria: The site displays the brand name "aura&adorn" prominently on the Home page and header
The Home page includes sections for Fashion, Jewelry, and Luxury products
Layout is usable on mobile and desktop (no horizontal scroll, readable typography)

requirements.text: Implement core affiliate browsing UX: category listing pages (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury) that show product cards (image, name, short description, price/price range optional), and a product details view with an external affiliate link button that opens in a new tab.

quotes: create a affiliate website for marketing... about fashion,jewelry and luxury products

acceptanceCriteria: Each category page shows a list/grid of products with images and titles
Each product has a details view (or expanded view) with a prominent "Shop" / "View Offer"-style outbound link
Outbound affiliate links open in a new browser tab

requirements.text: Add a basic product data model and persistence in the Motoko backend to support listing and viewing affiliate products, including fields: id, name, brand (optional), category (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury), shortDescription, imageUrl (or stored image reference), affiliateUrl, and optional price/priceRange.

quotes: affiliate website... fashion,jewelry and luxury products

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to list products by category and fetch a product by id
Backend exposes update methods to create/update/delete products
Data persists across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns appropriate for the template

requirements.text: Create a simple admin-only UI for managing affiliate products (create/edit/delete) and wire it to the backend; use Internet Identity login to gate access to the admin area (no third-party auth).

quotes: create a affiliate website for marketing

acceptanceCriteria: Admin page is not accessible unless the user is authenticated via Internet Identity
Admin can create, edit, and delete products and see changes reflected in category listings
Non-authenticated users can browse products but cannot access admin controls

requirements.text: Add required legal/affiliate transparency content: an "Affiliate Disclosure" page and a footer snippet indicating that the site may earn commissions from qualifying purchases.
acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated "Affiliate Disclosure" page exists and is reachable from the footer
Footer contains a short affiliate disclosure snippet in English

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, fashion-luxury visual theme (not blue/purple) across the entire UI, including typography, spacing, and components; keep it consistent across Home, category pages, product views, and admin pages.

quotes: account name is aura&adorn and it's basically about fashion,jewelry and luxury products.

acceptanceCriteria: A consistent palette and typography system is used across all pages
The design reads as luxury/fashion oriented (e.g., neutral tones, refined contrast, clean layout)
No pages fall back to unstyled default HTML appearance

requirements.text: Render the generated brand images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the header/hero section and favicon/app icon as appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI
Brand mark appears in the header and/or Home hero area
An app icon/favicon is set using generated assets

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files in frontend immutable paths (compose existing hooks/components instead).
Do not use third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is allowed.
nonGoals: No payments or checkout flow on this site.
No real-time features (chat, websockets, live updates).
No external database or cloud services.

required: Luxury fashion brand wordmark logo, black on transparent background (aura-adorn-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png)
Minimal monogram icon using letters A and A, black on transparent background (aura-adorn-monogram.dim_512x512.png)
Elegant neutral hero background with subtle fabric/jewelry-inspired texture (aura-adorn-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
